Agent.description:
Python wrapper for ISPL Agents.

See also the relevant [ISPL reference](http://mattvonrocketstein.github.io/py-mcmas/isplref/#agent)

evolution.description: Defines how an agent's local variables change in response to the actions performed by all agents.

Environment.description:
Python wrapper for ISPL Environments. Environments model the
shared information and boundary conditions that all other
agents can observe.

See also the relevant [ISPL reference](http://mattvonrocketstein.github.io/py-mcmas/isplref/#environment)

evolution.description: How variables change based on actions
evolution.title: Evolution

vars.description: Private variables. Only the Environment can access

FormulaeResult.description:
FormulaeResult partitions Formulae as True/False.

model- check runs.

SimMetadata describes status-related metadata from a
simulation.

Simulation.description:
A Simulation object is the result of having run a spec.

In practice a Simulation in `py-mcmas` is always an ISPL program
running on an MCMAS engine, but see `SimBase` for something more
generic.

witnesses.description: Witnesses, counter-examples, traces.  These are obtained by parsing mcmas .info files.  By default witnesses cover as many facts as possible; Use instead `counter_examples` to limit this to only FALSE statements.
witnesses.title: Witnesses

facts.description: Input formulae partitioned as true / false

description:
Python wrapper for ISPL specifications.

This permits partials or "fragments", i.e. the specification need not be complete and ready to run.

See the ISPL reference here: http://mattvonrocketstein.github.io/py-mcmas/isplref

metadata.description:
Known metadata about this Specification.

(Updated if/when the specification is analyzed or simulated)

title.description: Optional title.  Used as a comment at the top of the file
title.title: Title

agents.description: All agents involved in this specification.  A map of {name: agent_object}
agents.title: Agents

fairness.description: Specifies conditions that must hold infinitely often along all execution paths, used to rule out unrealistic behaviors.
fairness.title: Fairness

init_states.description: Initial global states of the system when verification begins.
init_states.title: Init States

evaluation.description: Calculations, composites, aggregates that can be referenced in formulae
evaluation.title: Evaluation

groups.description: A map of {group_name: [member1, .. ]}Defines collections of agents for use in group-based verification formulae.
groups.title: Groups

formulae.description:
A list of formulas.

These will be partitioned into true/false categories, per the rest of the model
formulae.title: Formulae

simulation.description: The result of simulating this specification.  Empty if simulation has never been run

source_code.description: Source code for this specification.  Only available if the specification was loaded from raw ISPL
source_code.title: Source Code
